title: Directory reorganization: lib/mitosis rename and docs merge

completion_criteria.text: The blast radius is re-derived as a closed census over the CURRENT tree that halts on anything unclassifiable, and every difference from 0340's 17-site count is explained rather than absorbed.
lib/superpowers-parallel becomes lib/mitosis and resolve-superpowers.mjs becomes superpowers-prompts.mjs, every load-bearing path string changing in the SAME commit.
docs/superpowers/{specs,plans} merge into the existing docs/{specs,plans}, and workflows/parallel-plan-execution.js becomes mitosis-execute.js together with its meta.name.
The dead .gitignore line is deleted rather than renamed, since it names a path nothing writes.
Behaviour-neutrality is proven by execution not inspection: drift-check hook, CI phase-parity, npm test glob, pr.mjs imports and mitosis.js LIB_DIR all resolve after the move.
A PR is opened through the centralized pr-create tool from a worktree branch, the primary checkout never leaves main, and phase 2 subdivision is left undone.

spine.active_goal: Land the decided rename as a pure move, prove it neutral, and leave the deploy sequence safe. Move and PR are done; only the live-resolution proof remains.
spine.next_step: c5 is the only open criterion and it cannot close until cutover: LIB_DIR resolves in-repo but ~/.claude/lib/mitosis does not exist yet, which is the same fact as 0345's deploy trap. Merge PR #64 and run the cutover as ONE operation with no session started between them, then confirm a fresh session starts clean and close c5. Then return to SPEC B (01KZQ2BVF2386ATV5YFD43NQVX) for scoping.
spine.last_session: Orchestrator ran the census, both commits, verification and the PR. Census found 31 load-bearing lines across 18 files, not 17 across 12. PR #64 is open and unmerged. Independently verified the commits, the guard change, the survivors and the clean primary checkout.

open_risks.text: Confirm the self-referential string inside resolve-superpowers.mjs was changed — it hardcodes its own old path and will not follow its own rename
Audit every Verified line on the PR rather than trusting it — the honesty rule forbids a verified line for a check that was not actually run and read, and a fabricated one reads as assurance

Merge PR #64 and run the cutover as ONE operation — between them the drift-check hook hard-fails exit 1 on an empty SessionStart matcher, so every new session errors, and no test catches it because the suite resolves against the worktree

Treat the pinned 17-site list as disproven rather than merely incomplete — the real census was 31 lines across 18 files, and the miss included the guard regex whose loss would have been silent with every test still green

Do not rename block-destructive-bash.test.mjs:280-281 — it deliberately pins a superseded path to assert that path carries no exemption, so renaming it would convert a dead-path regression test into a claim about the live canonical directory
Read the docs commit as 58 files with 2 insertions and 2 deletions — the agent reported it as 0 and 0, which understated two cross-boundary pointer edits it had itself classified as load-bearing
Give CI on the branch and an end-to-end engine run no evidentiary weight — both are disclosed as not run on the PR, so neither supports any claim about the move

key_decisions.title: The stale superpowers-parallel tree is renamed to lib/mitosis as a pure move before the SPEC
The rename executes in a worktree with the blast radius re-derived rather than trusted
Merging the rename and running the cutover are one operation, not two

out_of_scope: Phase 2 subdivision of lib/mitosis into engine, recovery, git and gates, deferred by 0340
Reconciling the diverged root-level docs/superpowers tree, which is a content merge and not a move
Any behavioural change at all; this is a pure move
Merging the pull request, which stays human-gated
